chunks: The sinners indeed laughed at believers
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how sinners treated believers?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah al-Mutaffifin, this verse exposes the superficial mockery of the elite who viewed the piety of the believers as foolishness, a theme deeply resonant in Shia tradition regarding the patience of the Imams amidst the ridicule of the Umayyad court. The laughter described is not merely jest but a manifestation of spiritual arrogance, contrasting the transient worldly status of the mockers with the eternal dignity of the faithful. This dynamic underscores the Shia emphasis on inner conviction over external validation, reminding believers that divine justice will ultimately reverse the scales of honor.
